name: Text Loop
description: Endless looping text that travels along an SVG path (wave, circle, infinity, arch, line or custom) on an optional colored ribbon, with hover pause, drag, scroll boost and optional crossing second ribbon.
contents: SVG with text repeated along a path, optionally on a colored ribbon stroke
Optional second crossing ribbon with its own text and drop shadow
Optional edge fade mask on left and right
behavior: Text scrolls continuously along the path at a set speed in either direction
Repeat count is measured so the text tiles seamlessly around the path
Hovering with a mouse eases the motion to a stop, leaving eases it back
When draggable, pointer drag moves the text and release flings it with momentum
When scrollBoost is above 0, page scroll speed adds to the text speed
Animation runs only while in view and stays still with prefers-reduced-motion
Cross ribbon runs in the opposite direction

props.name: path
props.type: string (SVG path d in a 1200x520 viewBox)

editableByProps: Text, separator, uppercase, font size, weight and letter spacing
Path shape or a custom SVG path, curviness, tilt
Speed, direction, hover pause, drag, scroll boost
Text color, ribbon on/off, ribbon color and width, outline text
Edge fade, crossing second ribbon with color and angle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the canvas proportions of the SVG
Add a new built-in path shape
needsCodeEdit.where: switch statement in the buildPath function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change hover ease time or fling decay
needsCodeEdit.where: glide function and fling decay in the tick function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the crossing ribbon text separately from the main text

fixed: Requires gsap, whose ticker drives the animation
Adds a capturing window scroll listener when scrollBoost is above 0
Cross ribbon text is the same as the main text and always runs opposite
Text is aria-hidden, the SVG carries the text as aria-label
Fills container width at a fixed 1200x520 aspect ratio, so the height scales with width and font size shrinks on small screens
Cross ribbon uses its own mirrored path only for wave, arch and circle (circle becomes an ellipse); ignored when custom path is set
Default text color is white on ribbon, currentColor without ribbon

options.look: Text flows along a horizontal sine-like wave
options.useWhen: Hero or section divider needing a lively full-width ticker
Badge or rotating seal beside a hero heading or CTA
Playful centerpiece in a brand or about section

options.look: Text follows a single curved arch
options.useWhen: Banner arcing over a heading or product image

options.look: Text runs along a straight horizontal line
options.useWhen: Classic marquee strip between sections or above the footer
